scope: Bounded startup, first-turn prelude, and effect-bearing warning exclusions. Family recognition is diagnostic only; no family is an authorization.

families.template: Ignored unsupported project-local config keys in {config_path}: {ignored_keys}. If you want these settings to apply, manually set them in your user-level config.toml.
families.condition: Supported trusted project config contains disallowed project-local keys.
families.logging: No producer body tracing in this formatter.

families.template: Ignoring deprecated managed config file at {path}; CODEX_HOME/managed_config.toml is no longer supported on Windows. Use %ProgramData%\OpenAI\Codex\requirements.toml for enforced settings or config.toml for defaults.
families.condition: Windows only, deprecated default managed config exists and is ignored.
families.logging: No body trace on successful warning branch.

families.template: Configured value for `{field_name}` is overridden by the required value {value:?} from {source}.
families.condition: Managed exact requirement conflicts with cli_auth_credentials_store/chatgpt_base_url/sqlite_home/log_dir/model_catalog_json/check_for_update_on_startup/allow_login_shell/windows.sandbox_private_desktop.
families.logging: Producer tracing includes field/value/source; textual diagnostic differs from wire warning.

families.template: Configured values under `{field_name}` are overridden by requirements from {source}.
families.condition: Managed feedback.enabled conflicts.
families.logging: Producer trace exists.

families.template: Ignoring `{RESIDENCY_HEADER_NAME}` in `model_providers.{provider_name}` because managed residency is required.
families.condition: Managed residency exists and provider contains residency header.
families.logging: Producer tracing prints full warning.

families.template: Environment value for `$CODEX_SQLITE_HOME` is overridden by the required `sqlite_home` value {value:?} from {source}.
families.condition: No configured sqlite_home, conflicting env and managed requirement.
families.logging: Producer trace exists.

families.template: `--dangerously-bypass-hook-trust` is enabled. Enabled hooks may run without review for this invocation.
families.condition: bypass_hook_trust true.
families.logging: No producer body trace in this branch.

families.template: Using legacy `features` requirement `{key}` from {source}; prefer canonical feature key `{canonical}`
families.condition: Requirement key uses recognized legacy alias.
families.logging: push_feature_requirement_warning traces full message.

families.template: Ignoring unknown `features` requirement `{key}` from {source}
families.condition: Requirement feature key not recognized.
families.logging: push_feature_requirement_warning traces full message.

families.template: Configured value for `{field_name}` is disallowed by requirements; falling back to required value {fallback_value:?}. Details: {err}
families.condition: Setter rejects windows.sandbox/approval_policy/approvals_reviewer/permission_profile/web_search_mode.
families.logging: Producer trace has field/fallback/source/error; not exact wire template.

families.template: Configured value for `permission_profile` is disallowed by requirements; falling back from `{selected_permissions}` to required value `{fallback_permissions}`.
families.condition: Selected named permission profile disallowed by requirements.
families.logging: No tracing statement in this exact branch.

families.template: Permissions profile `{profile_name}` does not define any recognized filesystem entries for this version of Codex. Filesystem access will remain restricted. Upgrade Codex if this profile expects filesystem permissions.
families.condition: Selected custom profile lacks recognized filesystem entries.
families.logging: push_warning traces full warning.

families.template: Filesystem glob `{pattern}` uses `read` or `write` access, which is not fully supported by this platform's sandboxing. Use an exact path or trailing `/**` subtree rule instead. `deny` globs are supported.
families.condition: Non-macOS selected custom profile has unsupported read/write glob.
families.logging: push_warning traces full warning.

families.template: Filesystem deny-read glob `{pattern}` uses `**`. Non-macOS sandboxing does not support unbounded `**` natively; set `glob_scan_max_depth` in this filesystem profile to cap Linux glob expansion and silence this warning, or enumerate explicit depths such as `*.env`, `*/*.env`, and `*/*/*.env`.
families.condition: Unbounded unreadable globstar on non-macOS custom profile.
families.logging: push_warning traces full warning.

families.template: Configured filesystem path `{path}` [with nested entry `{subpath}` ]is not recognized by this version of Codex and will be ignored. Upgrade Codex if this path is required.
families.condition: Unknown special path in selected profile; two exact source variants.
families.logging: push_warning traces full warning.

families.template: Ignoring malformed agent role definition: {err}
families.condition: Malformed/duplicate agent role definition; config loading scans roles independently of later agent execution.
families.logging: Producer traces full message.

families.template: Ignoring invalid `{config_key}` config: {err}
families.condition: Invalid otel.span_attributes or otel.tracestate; entries ignored.
families.logging: Producer traces full message.

families.template: Failed to read global AGENTS.md instructions from `{path}`: {err}
families.condition: Metadata/read error other than missing file for global instructions provider.
families.logging: Provider pushes warning without tracing the warning body.

families.template: Under-development features enabled: {sorted_canonical_keys}. Under-development features are incomplete and may behave unpredictably. To suppress this warning, set `suppress_unstable_features_warning = true` in {config_path}.
families.condition: Not suppressed; explicit effective config canonical feature=true or enabled=true; effective enabled; stage UnderDevelopment. Nonempty keys sorted.
families.logging: No producer body tracing. Full list of 48 keys in UNDER_DEVELOPMENT_FEATURES.json.

families.template: Open family of hook/plugin loading, schema, matcher, timeout and duplicate-representation diagnostics.
families.condition: CodexHooks feature enabled; engine new(enabled=false) short-circuits with empty warnings.
families.logging: Exact variable subfamilies in captured discovery.rs; do not admit broad hook text.

families.template: Configured service tier `{service_tier}` is not advertised as supported for model `{slug}` and will be omitted from requests.
families.condition: FastMode enabled, configured non-default tier, tier unsupported by model metadata.
families.logging: No direct body tracing in warning function or send_event path.

families.template: This session was recorded with model `{prev}` but is resuming with `{curr}`. Consider switching back to `{prev}` as it may affect Codex performance.
families.condition: Resumed history last model differs.
families.logging: Producer warns previous/current model with a different log template.

families.template: Model metadata for `{slug}` not found. Defaulting to fallback metadata; this can degrade performance and cause issues.
families.condition: ModelInfo.used_fallback_model_metadata true.
families.logging: models-manager/src/model_info.rs:143 independently traces unknown model, not exact notification.

families.template: Code Mode is unavailable because {error}. {behavior}; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.
families.condition: Runtime unavailable and requested_tool_mode metadata/feature result is CodeMode or CodeModeOnly; warning once. behavior is Falling back to direct tools or Code mode will fail closed.
families.logging: No direct body trace; formatter tools/code_mode/mod.rs:102.

families.template: Code Mode is enabled in configuration, but model `{model}` does not advertise Code Mode support. This may degrade model performance. Disable `features.code_mode` and `features.code_mode_only`, or select a model whose metadata enables Code Mode.
families.condition: CodeMode/CodeModeOnly feature enabled, model tool_mode None, no fallback metadata.
families.logging: No direct body trace in formatter or generic send_event path.

families.template: Falling back from WebSockets to HTTPS transport. {err:#}
families.condition: Streaming connection failed and transport fallback allowed.
families.logging: No direct body trace at this emission; separately logged transport errors may identify dependency failure.

families.template: Your account was flagged for potentially high-risk cyber activity and this request was routed to gpt-5.2 as a fallback. To regain access to gpt-5.3-codex, apply for trusted access: {CYBER_VERIFY_URL} or learn more: {CYBER_SAFETY_URL}
families.condition: Detected restricted cyber model reroute; separate ModelReroute event emitted first.
families.logging: Producer trace reports requested/server model.

families.template: Arbitrary hook output entry.text
families.condition: Finished hook result contains Warning entry.
families.logging: No general exact family boundary; reject.

families.template: Arbitrary host skill invocation warning
families.condition: Extension skill invocation outcome carries warnings.
families.logging: Provider-defined text; no general exact family boundary.

families.template: Stop hook requested continuation without a prompt; ignoring the block.
families.condition: Stop hook returned continuation without prompt.
families.logging: Unreachable before initial sampling.

families.template: Failed to save the conversation transcript; Codex will continue retrying. Error: {err}
families.condition: flush_rollout fails at task completion.
families.logging: Producer tracing has failure error.

families.template: Rolled the thread back, but failed to save the rollback marker. Codex will continue retrying. Error: {err}
families.condition: Rollback operation flush fails.
families.logging: Not reachable without rollback request.

families.template: Failed to apply execpolicy amendment: {err}
families.condition: ApprovedExecpolicyAmendment cannot persist.
families.logging: Producer traces full message.

families.template: Failed to apply network policy amendment: {err}
families.condition: Allow/deny network amendment persistence fails.
families.logging: Producer traces full message.

families.template: Heads up: Long threads and multiple compactions can cause the model to be less accurate. Start a new thread when possible to keep threads small and targeted.
families.condition: Compaction completion.
families.logging: Fresh bounded initial turn should not reach this producer.

template_note: Templates preserve fixed source text where a single formatter exists. Braced placeholders describe source variables, not safe regex wildcards. Open provider families and the explicit two-variant special-path summary are not executable matchers.
